findings.text: the production branch of _read_rollout is asserted by no case: both new cases inject a reader and the CLI case's pointer carries no session_id, so replacing that branch's reader call with an unmeasured answer leaves the gate at 34 passed EXIT=0 (scratch-copy falsifier, log stored beside this record), and a future regression that stopped reading the session's rollout would silently remove the third source with the whole suite green.

_run_observed_at duplicates reckon/mcp_views.py:78 _receipt_observed_at with a differing key list, and the divergence is measured, not theoretical: 29 of the 35 live records on this workstation are datable by the new helper and undated by the lanes view's, every one of them a record whose only stamp is created_at, so the lanes view and a group's pace date the same session differently; mcp_views imports budget, so budget is the lower layer and one helper can serve both.

the competition takes one reading per member wholesale on observed_at, and the third source's real receipts carry only the weekly window ({10080: 46.0} on nova's live sessions), so a rollout reading that wins leaves the five-hour clock unknown where the committed row it displaced may have carried a figure; no case asserts the mixed outcome, and the node disclosed this itself - it is the interaction a per-window choice or an assertion of the wholesale shape would settle.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against f29aa1fb; e5cf008e inverts the receipt loop without changing its outcome, adds _run_observed_at, _read_rollout, _rollout_reading and the _reset_text guard for the unmeasured marker, and builds the third candidate beside the receipt and stream candidates on the same observed_at competition; 6001f577 carries docs alone, insert-only, with the figure under docs/figures/a-window-paces-the-lane/.
item_verdicts.done_when: every clause is checkable and I checked each - the rollout case asserts both clocks and observed_at one minute old (0.11 five_hour, 0.17 seven_day), the unmeasured-or-absent case is parametrised over both markers and asserts the fallback to the ledger row (0.42 and 0.21, its 3 h stamp), the foreign-pointer case asserts the foreign 0.91 receipt is ignored and 0.42 reported, the base file's own 30 cases pass against this tree (base-suite.log, 30 passed exit 0; the test diff is 208 insertions and zero deletions), the production run is captured with the group observed (codex-sub 0.31 at 2026-09-21T20:53:30+00:00, EXIT=0), and the negative control's first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim with the named case red at assert 0.91 == 0.42.
item_verdicts.goal: recorded_windows now reads each declared-group member's newest live run by session_id and builds that session's rollout receipt as a third candidate reading, through a one-argument seam interchangeable with the one the lanes view injects (reckon/mcp_views.py:689-692), with the pointer read's project filter asserted by the foreign-pointer case; both production call sites take the default (reckon/cli.py:963, reckon/mcp.py:3242), and I verified the source resolves real receipts on this workstation, not just fixtures: nova's live codex sessions answer {10080: 46.0} at run stamp 2026-09-22T12:08:38Z and {10080: 56.0} at 12:22:08Z, read through the reviewed reader.
item_verdicts.manifest: the run manifest records status complete, both commits, a gate result matching its log to the line, the declared mutation verbatim on the control log's first line, the honest statement that neither project read a rollout reading because the committed rows out-dated them, and a checkpoint naming the plan status and driving followup as the coordinator's; its one shape point is that baseline_suite/after_suite/failure_attribution carry prose where the contract asks for armed-only JSON, informative but in the wrong field.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the two commits touch exactly the five declared paths (numstat e5cf008e: reckon/budget.py 141/7, tests/test_preflight_pace.py 208/0; 6001f577: plan 64/0, evidence 123/0, figure 71/0), every docs change is insert-only, and no plan-version or plan-modified line appears anywhere in the diff.

justifications.durability: each added case names the change that reddens it and they assert code output against fixture arithmetic rather than values handed to the code, the receipts are built from the production types so a receipt-shape change fails them, and the declared negative control is real and independently reproduced by me from the stored log - but two gaps are measured rather than argued: replacing the production reader call with an unmeasured answer leaves the gate at 34 passed exit 0 (my scratch falsifier, review-falsifier-production-branch.log), so nothing covers the branch that reads a session's rollout in production; and the wholesale competition has no case for a rollout reading carrying only the weekly window, which is exactly what real receipts carry (measured), so a winning rollout reading would leave the five-hour clock unknown where a displaced row may have carried one.
justifications.evidence: every artifact the done_when names is on disk and each checked out - my own re-run of the named gate at the committed head is 34 passed exit 0 with in-process provenance naming the reviewed tree and the reviewed worktree left clean, the base file's 30 cases pass unchanged, the red log's first line is the mutation verbatim with the named assertion going 0.91 against 0.42 and the mutated run printing its own scratch copy's budget.py - against two deductions: the half of the production claim that the third source resolves (46.0 and 56.0 percent from nova's live sessions) exists only as prose in the plan and manifest with no log artifact, so a later reader cannot check it from the run even though I verified it live; and the gate log names the base revision with "(uncommitted worktree; the commit follows the format pass)" rather than the head, so tying 34 passed to 6001f577 needed my re-run to establish.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's own idiom - an injectable keyword defaulting to the real source beside the existing records and pointers keywords, mechanism docstrings on each new helper, and a guard that treats the unmeasured marker as no reset rather than printing a reason where a deadline belongs - with the deduction that _run_observed_at restates an existing helper's question with a different answer.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal's rule is implemented exactly and tested where a fixture cannot reach: the member's newest datable run carrying a session_id supplies the session, the receipt is dated by that record and competes on observed_at with the other two sources, and I confirmed against the live crew home that the selection rule picks a session for every backend that has one (claude, clive, codex, codex-astra) and that the receipts behind them resolve real readings.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat f29aa1fb..6001f577 lists exactly the five declared paths, 607 insertions and 7 deletions, the 7 all in budget.py's loop restructure; both docs records are insert-only and no plan-version or plan-modified line is touched; the added code and comments name no plan, sprint, ticket or gate label.
